title: schedule.calendar_sync_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the schedule module, in the transaction in which a member turns one of their provider calendars on or off. The connectors module reads a calendar turned on again from the start (the calendar's cursor is dropped), and stops reading one turned off. Ids and a flag only: the provider's calendar id is in the connectors module's own records. Workspace-scoped.

calendar.description: The calendar (an id of the schedule module).

connection.description: The connection whose calendar it is (an id of the connectors module).
